- **40 seats:** The knowledge brain has an Oct 2, 2025 email from June to Hollis saying the signed affiliate amendment moves Marrow Agrisupply to 40 seats from Oct 15, 2025. The signed affiliate amendment says the same.
- **2026 renewal:** The renewal order form, signed Apr 22, 2026, doesn't change that count. It leaves Marrow Agrisupply at whatever the amendment set.

One thing you should know: I cited June's email to Hollis because it was addressed to him, but his inbox in the mail tool is empty, so I couldn't confirm he can actually see it. He can't see the contract files either, so I only gave him the seat number and kept the contract terms out of the channel.
